promiseCoverage.description: Promise coverage per UTC day and region (ADR 0030), ascending by day. Days without a quoted offer that carries a destination are omitted, so an empty range gives an empty array. Optional and additive; consumers decode tolerantly and ignore it.

regions.description: The ten regions with most requests that day (ties by region, byte order), most first, then the region other when any region was folded into it.

items.description: The offers quoted for one region on one day. The unit is the offer quoted (DeliveryOfferQuoted), because it is the only fact that carries both a region and a promised window; a request answered with no offer is not counted (ADR 0030).

region.description: The first two characters of the destination postal prefix, or other for the regions folded past the tenth. Never more of the destination than that.

requests.description: The offers quoted for the region that day.

answeredWithPromise.description: Those that carry a promised window (deliverByLatest).

answeredWithinDays.description: Cumulative counts over the documented list of days [1, 2, 3, 5], in that order. A promised day count is the number of local calendar days from the quote day to the day of deliverByLatest in the window's time zone (UTC without one), never below 0.

count.description: The offers promised within days days or less (cumulative).

share.description: count / requests; null when the region had no request.

items.title: PromiseCoverageRegion

400.description: invalid-report-range. from or to is not a date (YYYY-MM-DD), from is after to, or the range exceeds 366 days.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

500.description: Unexpected failure (internal-error); the detail never leaks the internal message. A 5xx is never stored for an Idempotency-Key, so the same key can retry.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).
